fields.label: Channel Allocation — v2
fields.description: Controls phone vs walk-in capacity split for the new admission flow.

fields.label: Phone Booking %
fields.description: % of planned capacity available for advance phone bookings.

fields.label: Release Phone Slots (hours before session — v2)
fields.description: Configurable transitional rule: unused phone slots may convert to walk-in capacity this many hours before session start.

fields.label: Special Buffer — v2 (legacy field names kept)
Special Buffer Tokens Per Session
fields.description: Legacy compatibility setting. Total number of token positions previously reserved as VIP/special buffers per session.

fields.label: Special Buffer Interval
fields.description: Legacy compatibility setting. Place one special buffer token every N positions (e.g. 15 = positions 15, 30, 45...).

fields.label: ETA Defaults — v2
fields.description: Used when insufficient live session data exists for rolling averages.

fields.label: Reception Processing Time (minutes)
fields.description: Expected time for payment + weight + formalities at reception desk.

fields.label: Ready Buffer Count
fields.description: How many patients should be ready near doctor ahead of current consultation.

fields.label: Reporting Safety Margin (minutes)
fields.description: Extra buffer subtracted from report_by_time to account for variance.

fields.label: Rolling Average Window (days)
fields.description: How many past days of session data to use for live ETA averages.

fields.label: Minimum Samples for Live Average
fields.description: Fall back to defaults if fewer than this many consultations have completed today.

fields.label: No-Response Grace Count
fields.description: Number of later patients that must complete reception before a No Response token is auto-pushed to end.

fields.label: Special Reception Warning (minutes)
fields.description: Elapsed arrival time before an arrived special patient enters warning state.

fields.label: Special Reception Escalation (minutes)
fields.description: Elapsed arrival time before an arrived special patient enters escalation state.

fields.label: Special Reception Target (minutes)
fields.description: Target maximum elapsed arrival time for special reception handling.

fields.label: Special Gap Lookahead Tokens
fields.description: How many upcoming normal tokens to inspect for one non-arrival gap.

fields.label: Max Consecutive Special Reception Calls
fields.description: Maximum special reception calls in a row while normal arrived patients are waiting.
